info.title: GoldEx-Backend
info.description: Every response is wrapped: `{ status, message, data }`. Errors use the same envelope with `data: null` and a localised `message` — send `Accept-Language: fa` for Persian.  Amounts are decimal strings in their symbol's own units. The backend works in rial (IRR); showing toman is the panels' job.
